name: Builds Release
description: A workflow run is the one that (most likely) produced this release. DERIVED, not reported: GitHub records who published a release but not which run did, so the edge is inferred from the run's head commit or tag ref, and `match_kind` says which. Runs triggered BY the release (`event: release`) are excluded — they consume it. The corpus's `BUILDS_PACKAGE_VERSION` rule applies: its absence is a finding, but only after `match_kind` has been read.

match_kind.description: How the run was matched to the release. `tag_ref`: the run's `head_branch` IS the release's tag name — a tag-push run, the strongest signal GitHub offers. `same_commit`: the run's `head_sha` is the commit the release tag resolves to — co-location on a commit, which every workflow that ran on that push shares, so several runs may carry it.

head_sha.description: The run's head commit at match time, so the edge is checkable without re-reading either node.
